sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY

-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Manoj Kr. Dash, Advocate  For the State : Ms. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P.
 -----
 Oral Order  04 / Dated : 13.09.2024  Heard learned counsel for the parties.
The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Jadugora P.S. Case No. 44 of 2023 (Spl. POCSO Case No. 51 of 2023) for the offence under Sections 376(3), 376(DA), 323/34 of Indian Penal Code and Section 4 and 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Special Judge,
Exclusive (POCSO) Court, Jamshedpur.
As per the FIR, gang rape was committed by this petitioner with two others on a minor girl aged about 14 years.
She was enticed away and was taken in a jungle area.
While being taken, one Haricharan Gope tried to dissuade the petitioner from taking the minor girl, on which he was assaulted.
Later on, after returning from jungle, the victim narrated the incident to her parents and the father had lodged the case.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that there is four days delay in lodging the FIR.
In her deposition in paragraph 9, she deposed that the name of Pandu has been taken by the petitioner and he had taken her to the jungle area.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner is named in the FIR and the victim has given her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., naming the petitioner to be involved in committing gang rape.
Considering the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) AKT/Satendra Chopon Mahakur @ Gopinath Mahakur @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp
